<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/feature-split.ts -->
<!--
  Features beside a picture. Axes: layout (grid: four plain features in two columns, cards: four features as
  cards and the actions, stats: two figure cards over three checked rows beside a square picture, metrics: four
  metric cards and the actions), mediaSide, tone.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Feature } from "./feature-grid.types";
  import type { Stat } from "./stats-band.types";
  import type { LinkActions } from "./error-page.types";

  export type FeatureSplitProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    lead?: string;
    badge?: string;
    level?: 1 | 2;
    features: Feature[];
    stats: Stat[];
    actions: LinkActions;
    layout?: "grid" | "cards" | "stats" | "metrics";
    mediaSide?: "end" | "start";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import ActionGroup from "../components/action-group.svelte";
  import FeatureCards from "../components/feature-cards.svelte";
  import FeatureMetricCards from "../components/feature-metric-cards.svelte";
  import FeaturePairs from "../components/feature-pairs.svelte";
  import FeatureStatRows from "../components/feature-stat-rows.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    lead = "",
    badge = "",
    level = 2,
    features,
    stats,
    actions,
    layout = "grid",
    mediaSide = "end",
    tone = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: FeatureSplitProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame
  id={id}
  title={title}
  lead={lead}
  heading={{ badge, level }}
  tone={tone}
  layout="split"
  media={{ show: true, side: mediaSide }}
  landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}
>
  {#if ((layout as string) === "grid")}
    <FeaturePairs features={features} />
  {/if}
  {#if ((layout as string) === "cards")}
    <FeatureCards features={features} cols="1-2" item="tile" />
  {/if}
  {#if ((layout as string) === "stats")}
    <FeatureStatRows features={features} stats={stats} />
  {/if}
  {#if ((layout as string) === "metrics")}
    <FeatureMetricCards stats={stats} />
  {/if}
  {#if (((layout as string) === "cards") || ((layout as string) === "metrics"))}
    <ActionGroup
      primary={actions.cta}
      primaryHref={actions.href}
      secondary={((actions.mode === "two") ? actions.secondary : undefined)}
      secondaryHref={actions.secondaryHref}
    />
  {/if}
  {#snippet aside()}
    <MediaFrame alt={title} ratio={(((layout as string) === "stats") ? "1/1" : "4/3")} />
  {/snippet}
</SectionFrame>
